bounded_interpretation.observation: Natural movement reaches health -1 on lives 0 and selects game-over flow. With only lives 0->1 at the same anchor it restores health 4 and decrements lives to 0 in scene 9. With only pre-death movement neutralized no damage occurs. Natural fourth Start executes scene_config_apply and writes lives 0->5; removing only that Start leaves lives 0.
bounded_interpretation.inference: Lives zero is the final playable life; death then selects game over, while ordinary death restores health and consumes one stored life. Continue applies scene configuration whose first byte supplies the five-life reset.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: The controls alter exactly one RAM byte, 82 pre-death input frames, or the seven fourth-Start samples. Fixed-frame traces are RAM/register/cycle/frame neutral against their own uninstrumented runs and exact writer PCs are byte-pinned.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: This recording does not close checkpoint coupling, every hazard/death class, Continue menu choice breadth, card-save effects, stage breadth, or C15/E10/E14 ownership.

bounded_open_frontier.checkpoint_interaction: C15 must reproduce mid-level checkpoint capture and death restore before C16 can claim checkpoint coupling.
bounded_open_frontier.death_classes: Join representative pit, actor/contact and scripted hazard deaths to the same scene-flow boundary without borrowing enemy or hazard-family completion.
bounded_open_frontier.menu_and_save: Reproduce Continue versus alternate frontend choices and join E14 native card serialization before claiming save policy.
bounded_open_frontier.stage_breadth: The dedicated natural game-over anchor is Bug Bar only; other stage classes remain supporting Phase-2 breadth, not C16 closure.
bounded_open_frontier.next_experiment: Select an existing mid-level death recording that crosses an authored checkpoint, then trace checkpoint capture, respawn restore, and Continue/card boundaries separately.
